_comment: Per-mob per-key version constraints for check_entity_nbt_keys. Covers the keys most likely to cause silent bugs in Moogs mods; extend as new version-gated keys are found. min_dv / max_dv are DataVersion integers (from misode/mcmeta versions.json). A key with only min_dv is invalid before that DV. A key with only max_dv is invalid from that DV onward. Both can be set. All boundaries are inclusive. A key whose boundary predates every supported version is still worth listing when it is dead everywhere: the game ignores it, and the entity silently gets its default.

Motive.note: Renamed to 'variant' in 1.19 (22w16a, DV 3091; misode/technical-changes: "Renamed fields Motive -> variant and Facing -> facing"). Every supported version reads 'variant' only, so a 'Motive' key is ignored and the painting falls back to the default variant. The 1.21 change (24w18a) made painting variants data-driven and did not touch the key.

variant.note: Wolf variants (e.g. minecraft:pale) added in 1.20.5 (DV 3837). Pre-1.20.5 wolves had no variant key.
